question: Does the midpoint Dusk tempo and stronger planned completion policy retain four causal packages without stalls or broad RandomBuild movement?

provenance.v4StallDiagnostic: seed 98030, Duskblade vow 5 arm 3; v5 prototype completed in 29 turns

competingOptions.statement: All packages remain distinct and practical, planned policies complete them, and whole-run guardrails stay bounded.
A package collapses or the exact candidate causes a stall, global movement, identity, C2 or Vow-5 failure.

estimands.functionalSeparation: Named diagonal interaction lower 95% bound at least 0.25 SD; every off-diagonal upper bound below 0.25.
estimands.panelActivation: Named consumer response in AB minus B, standardised by pooled consumer response; lower 95% bound at least 0.25 SD.
estimands.policySensitivity: At least eight independent policies per package and split apply and consume the mediator with positive consumer activation.
estimands.buildSensitivity: A planned build policy receives two existing aspect-bonus units only when a reward completes a package already represented in its deck. RandomBuild is unchanged.
estimands.reliability: Applicable-aspect package panels add no non-win and do not lengthen combat; whole-run errors and stalls fail closed.
estimands.reachability: Legacy rewards acquire, play and activate both components for at least two distinct policies per applicable aspect/vow and split, or a frozen deterministic acquisition proof passes.
estimands.globalMovement: Candidate-minus-live RandomBuild arm-2 win-rate point movement is at most 0.10 in magnitude per grid; an interval crossing the bound extends under the frozen ladder.

successRule.functionalSeparation: All four diagonals and twelve off-diagonals pass discovery and held-out evidence.
successRule.packageActivation: All four packages meet activation, witness, aspect-separation, reliability and duration gates in both splits.
successRule.aspectIdentity: Scoreline and Afterimage remain Dusk-only; Smolder and Bloodfire remain Ash-only.
successRule.reachability: All four packages meet the legacy-economy rule in both splits.
successRule.globalMovement: Every held-out RandomBuild movement is within 0.10.
successRule.c2: In every grid, RandomBuild arm 2 is below 0.50 and the top viable landscape policy minus arm 2 is at least 0.35.
successRule.vow5: Every held-out top viable-policy win rate is at most 0.90.

cheapestDiscriminatingExperiment: Re-run separation and panels, then paired 32-seed controls. Landscape work starts only after controls clear or remain genuinely inconclusive under the frozen ladder.
inconclusiveRule: Intervals overlapping a threshold at 32 extend to 64 and 128 on the same cohort. At 128 they stop inconclusive. Candidate values, pilot logic and estimands do not change.
stopRule: Reject immediately after any decisive package, separation, reliability, global-movement, identity, C2 or Vow-5 failure. Detector mutations remain forbidden until all content gates pass.
